# Media fixtures

Tiny synthetic clips used by the real-mpv tests (`crates/lucerna-testkit/tests/real_mpv.rs`).

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `sample.mp4` | H.264, 64x64, 1 s, 10 fps, no audio |
| `sample.webm` | VP9, 64x64, 1 s, 10 fps, no audio |
| `sample.mkv` | H.264 in Matroska, 64x64, 1 s, 10 fps, no audio |
| `sample.gif` | 16-colour looping GIF, 64x64, 1 s, 10 fps |
| `corrupt.mp4` | 4 KiB of random bytes with a video extension; mpv must fail on it gracefully |

## Provenance and license

All clips are generated by `scripts/gen-fixtures.sh` from ffmpeg's `lavfi` `testsrc` pattern, so no
third-party content is included. They are dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Regenerating
them needs ffmpeg with libx264 and libvpx-vp9; nothing at runtime does.
